sources.fact: LBBD61/AM Crown House is 0.42ha, 396 net dwellings, mixed ownership, permissioned by full planning permission dated 10 July 2020; notes state Development commenced.
Exact application 18/01972/FUL covers Crown House and Linton Road Car Park redevelopment for 396 residential units and 430sqm flexible commercial floorspace.
Committee material records 169 sub-market homes in Building A and 227 private rented units in Building B, totalling 396.
Committee grant was subject to Mayor/S106/conditions; permission scope and conditions are kept separate from land-title evidence.
February 2020 Cabinet approved appropriation of Crown House/Linton Road land for planning purposes and reliance on statutory powers to facilitate development.
Appropriation/powers facilitate development and third-party-interest handling but do not identify every current HMLR title/proprietor relation.
January 2023 decision approved long lease of Block B at Challingsworth House (formerly Crown House) comprising 56 Shared Ownership homes and associated loan.
The 56-home Block B lease is concrete partial delivery/tenure evidence but is not treated as proof that all 396 homes are complete or occupied.
Adopted Local Plan context retains AM allocation; allocation is not substituted for exact permission/title evidence.
Exact application/decision references are required for current case status.
Planning Data point/register information is not converted into exact title or red-line geometry.
Brownfield current status/capacity is authoritative register evidence and remains separate from HMLR title/owner and executed overlay evidence.

examples.result: AM remains a current 396-home permissioned/commenced Brownfield candidate.

56 delivered/leased homes are not extrapolated to whole-scheme completion.
